findings.title: Require baseline and before probe when a NOTICES action settles, including timeout prefixes
findings.problem: F1's baseline check currently runs only when a before-probe record exists. A settled NOTICES actionthrow without any baseline or probe can end a timeout journal and be accepted as an honest prefix. The window ruling permits a prefix before baseline only while that action remains unfinished; a completed entered action must have baseline and ordered required probes.
